source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.9.2, printed pages 17-18, with Quick Check 1.8 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Chlorine doosre elements ke saath jo compounds banati hai unhein chlorides kehte hain. Jab chlorides ko pani mein dala jaye to yeh khaas rawaiya dikhate hain, aur jo solution banta hai woh acidic ya neutral ho sakta hai.

Neutral chlorides woh salts hain jo pani mein hal ho kar neutral solution dete hain, jis ka pH 7 ke qareeb hota hai. Period 3 ke shuru mein sodium aur magnesium ke chlorides pani se react nahi karte. Solution mein positive metal ions aur negative chloride ions hote hain jo pani ke molecules se ghire hote hain. Aise ions ko hydrated ions kehte hain aur is amal ko hydration kehte hain. Misal:
Group 1 aur group 2 ke chlorides bhi, chand exceptions ke ilawa, neutral hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab Mg ion ko “Mg⁺²” likhti hai; aam tareeqa Mg²⁺ hai (pehle number, phir sign). MgCl₂ ka pH 6.5, yani thora sa acidic, is liye ke chhota Mg²⁺ ion pani ke molecules ko halka sa kheenchta hai.

Period 3 mein aluminium se sulfur tak tamam chlorides pani se react kar ke acidic solution banate hain jis ka pH 7 se kam hota hai; is amal ko hydrolysis (pani se toot jana) kehte hain. Jab AlCl₃ pani mein dala jata hai to aluminium aur chloride ions solution mein aa jate hain. Al³⁺ ion hydrate hota hai aur pani ke ek molecule se H⁺ ion alag karwa deta hai; yahi hydrolysis hai. Is se solution acidic ho jata hai. Reaction yeh hai:

blocks.prompt: a) ZnO HCl se react kar ke ZnCl₂ aur NaOH se react kar ke Na₂ZnO₂ deta hai. Equations likhein aur batayein yeh kis qism ka oxide hai.
blocks.explanation: ZnO + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂O, aur ZnO + 2NaOH → Na₂ZnO₂ + H₂O. Kyun ke ZnO acid aur base dono se react karta hai, yeh Al₂O₃ ki tarah amphoteric oxide hai.

blocks.prompt: b) AlCl₃ acidic halide kyun hai jab ke NaCl nahi?
blocks.explanation: NaCl pani mein sirf hal hota hai: us ke ions hydrate ho jate hain aur solution neutral (pH 7) rehta hai. AlCl₃ mein chhota aur zyada charge wala Al³⁺ ion pani ke molecule se H⁺ alag karwa deta hai (hydrolysis), HCl banta hai aur solution acidic ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Batayein ke chlorides PCl₅ aur NCl₃ acidic honge ya basic, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Dono non-metals ke covalent chlorides hain, is liye NaCl ki tarah sirf hal nahi hote balke pani se hydrolysis karte hain; koi bhi basic nahi. PCl₅ + 4H₂O → H₃PO₄ + 5HCl, is liye PCl₅ wazeh taur par acidic hai. NCl₃ bhi hydrolysis karta hai (NH₃ aur HOCl bante hain); yeh bhi NaCl jaisa neutral salt nahi.

blocks.prompt: d) SO₂ aur P₂O₅ HCl aur H₂SO₄ se react karenge ya NaOH se?
blocks.explanation: NaOH se. SO₂ aur P₂O₅ acidic oxides hain, is liye yeh bases se react kar ke salt aur pani dete hain (maslan SO₂ + 2NaOH → Na₂SO₃ + H₂O), acids (HCl, H₂SO₄) se nahi.

items: Neutral chlorides (NaCl pH 7, MgCl₂ pH 6.5) sirf hydrate hote hain.
Al se S tak acidic chlorides hydrolysis kar ke HCl dete hain: AlCl₃ → Al(OH)₃, SiCl₄ → SiO₂, PCl₃ → H₃PO₃, har ek ke saath HCl.
